verdict.rationale: uv itself stores project data in standard, portable formats. Dependencies go into `pyproject.toml` (uv-docs-2), scripts use the standard inline `# /// script` metadata block (uv-docs-3, uv-comm-4), and it builds and publishes standard distributions even for projects not managed with uv (uv-docs-75, uv-comm-9). However, the evidence shows no explicit export command or documented path for leaving, and `uv.lock` is a uv-specific lockfile (uv-docs-17). Missing for 10: a documented export of the lockfile/environment to an open, tool-neutral format (e.g. requirements.txt), migration-away guidance, and independent confirmation that projects move cleanly to other tools.
